description: Find the HKEX stock code for a company by name — the lookup step before hk_quote. Answers 'what is Tencent's Hong Kong ticker', 'Xiaomi HK code', 'Alibaba Hong Kong listing'. Returns ONLY Hong Kong-listed equities: derivative warrants, CBBCs and non-HK listings (ADRs, US/Frankfurt lines) are excluded, and each match states the code it resolved to so you can confirm it is the company you meant before quoting it. Source: Yahoo Finance search (keyless).

name.description: Company name, in English or Chinese, e.g. "Tencent", "小米", "HSBC".

name: hk_resolve_symbol
